hints.title: Calculate Digit Sum
hints.text: Write a helper to sum the decimal digits of each number.

hints.title: Bucket Frequencies
hints.text: The maximum sum of digits for numbers up to 10^5 is 9 * 5 = 45; allocate an array to track counts.

hints.title: Scan Range and Find Peak
hints.text: Iterate from lowLimit to highLimit, increment the corresponding box, and return the maximum box count.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; counting digit sums directly is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed-size array of 50 buckets consumes constant O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that digit sum cannot exceed 45 for 5-digit integers.
